item.title: Show HN: The King Wen Permutation: [52, 10, 2]
item.description:
📝 Treating the map between them as a permutation in S₆₄, its cycle decomposition yields [52, 10, 2] with zero fixed points. 81% of hexagrams are locked in a single cycle. This structure has not been previously reported in the literature.
🔗 Read more: https://gzw1987-bit.github.io/iching-math/

item.title: Plane and ground vehicle collide at New York's LaGuardia airport halting flights
item.description:
📝 Two pilots dead after plane and ground vehicle collide at New York's LaGuardia Airport22 minutes agoShareSaveOlivia IrelandShareSaveVideo shows damaged Air Canada plane at LaGuardia airport after collisionTwo pilots have died after an Air Canada plane collided with a firefighting vehicle responding to a separate incident at LaGuardia Airport. The plane was carrying 72 people and four crew members, and the vehicle was carrying two, Port Authority executive director Kathryn Garcia confirmed. Garcia said 32 people were discharged but others had serious injuries.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy01g522ww4o
